name: cc-pitstop
description: Pauses Claude Code before the 5-hour or weekly usage limit, across every session on the machine, and resumes the paused work on its own when the window resets.

warn5h.title: Warn at (5-hour %)
warn5h.description: 5-hour usage at which the model is told to land the current thread.

park5h.title: Park at (5-hour %)
park5h.description: 5-hour usage at which every session pauses until the window resets.

warnWeekly.title: Warn at (weekly %)
warnWeekly.description: Weekly usage at which the model is told to land the current thread.

parkWeekly.title: Park at (weekly %)
parkWeekly.description: Weekly usage at which every session pauses until the window resets.

graceRequests.title: Grace requests
graceRequests.description: Requests the main thread may still make after it reads the stop note, to save its state. All subagents share a pool of 3.
